newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Haier to expand washing machine output.
newsitem.headline: China's Haier to expand washing machine output.

text.p: China's Haier Group Co, parent of Qingdao Haier Refrigerator Co, has launched the second phase of a project to expand washing machine production, company officials said on Friday.
"The project is expected to be completed next October," an official of the Haier Group said.
The company's annual washing machine production capacity would be raised to about 800,000 from 300,000, the official said.
"It will be Asia's biggest export base for front-opening washing machines," he said but declined to give further details.
